technology_name: A DEVICE AND METHOD FOR POWER MANAGEMENT IN A DC NANOGRID POWER DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Grid Controller / Power Management System
problem_solved: Unmanaged 48V DC nanogrids encounter critical voltage fluctuations and control instability when multiple appliances change power loads dynamically without a centralized protocol.
description: A specialized power management assembly consisting of smart nano-socket units positioned between appliances and power lines, regulated via an intelligent Nanogrid System Controller (NSC) that dynamically assigns temporary network addresses over a CAN network bus.
applications: Smart residential DC nanogrids, telecommunication tower backup infrastructure, off-grid solar power storage networks, and micro-scale green energy grids.
